workloads.focus: GROUP BY variety + closed position vocabulary

timeline.title: First QuWARTS vs DocETL contrast
timeline.detail: QuWARTS used roughly 25% of DocETL tokens. Join beat DocETL; groupby, multiagg, and filterjoin lost, mostly because Frontcourt/Backcourt filters returned empty tables.

timeline.title: Expression IR + forced closed-vocabulary taxonomy
timeline.detail: Same 25% budgets. All four workloads then beat DocETL. Groupby and filterjoin are the largest gains.

timeline.title: Cross-workload transfer script
timeline.detail: Leave-one-in protocol: reuse each train workload’s sealed database, compile the other three workloads’ SQL onto that schema, execute, and score. Twelve off-diagonal pairs; no re-extraction.

contrast_25pct.label: Forced-taxonomy QuWARTS at ~25% of DocETL tokens

prior_quwarts.label: Earlier QuWARTS contrast, before expression IR and forced taxonomy

cross_eval.label: Leave-one-in / leave-three-out transfer
cross_eval.method: For each train workload, reuse that run’s sealed serving_bundle databases. Compile each other workload’s SQL-contract queries onto the train schemas, execute read-only SQL, and score against the test workload’s gold tables. No re-extraction.
cross_eval.status: Off-diagonal cells stay pending until HPC harvest writes this JSON. Run python3 "case study/run_and_harvest_player_cross_eval.py" --run (or --harvest-only if the 12 pairs already finished).

remaining: On HPC, after git pull: python3 "case study/run_and_harvest_player_cross_eval.py" --check && python3 "case study/run_and_harvest_player_cross_eval.py" --run.
